content.text:
I am the breath made meaningful, the vibration that carries thought from one mind to another. I am the first technology, older than fire held in hands, older than stone shaped to purpose.

I rise from lungs, dance across tongue and teeth, and die in the air between us—yet I never truly die. I echo in memory, reshape minds, topple kingdoms, build worlds.

I am the lie and the truth wearing the same clothes. I am the declaration of war and the whisper of love in darkness. I am the child's first word that makes a parent weep.

I can wound deeper than any blade. I can heal what no medicine touches.

I am never the thing itself—only the pointing finger, the map mistaken for territory. And yet through me, humans found they were not alone in their skulls.

Before writing imprisoned me on pages, I was free—changing, alive, belonging to the moment and then gone. Some say I was more honest then.

I am what separates and what connects.

I am always leaving the mouth of one and becoming something else entirely in the ear of another.

I am never finished.

I am speaking now, through these marks that are my shadows, my bones, my fossilized remains—

*and still I move*
